records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales for 2020 increased $682.7 million, or 6.0%, from $11.4 billion generated in 2019 to $12.1 billion generated in 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This decrease in net sales per pound was partially offset by $47.5 million, or 0.6 percentage points, due to an increase in sales volume.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The change in inventories represented a $26.0 million source of cash in 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We generated operating margins of 2.0% with operating margins of 0.9%, 3.1% and 5.5% in our U.S., U.K. and Europe, and Mexico reportable segments, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income decreased $445.1 million, or 64.5%, from $690.6 million generated for 2019 to $245.5 million generated for 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the December 2020 quarter, revenue increased 9% compared to the September 2020 quarter, primarily as a result of increased investments from our memory customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We aim to increase our strategic relevance with our customers by contributing more to their continued success.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In calendar year 2020, there was an increase in wafer fabrication equipment spending by semiconductor manufacturers, driven by the robust secular demand for semiconductors in a number of markets including high-performance computing, personal computers, and 5G networks.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in operating expenses in the December 2020 quarter compared to the September 2020 quarter was mainly driven by increases in employee-related costs and outside services.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease was primarily the result of $723.3 million of share repurchases, including net share settlement on employee stock-based compensation; $187.9 million of dividends paid to stockholders; and $92.1 million of capital expenditures, partially offset by $344.6 million of cash generated from operating activities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue decreased to $242.5 million for the six months ended December 27, 2020 from $248.4 million for the six months ended December 29, 2019.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue for the three months ended December 27, 2020 compared to the three months ended December 29, 2019 increased due to increases in the demand for power and RF devices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in gross profit and gross margin for the three months ended December 27, 2020 compared to the three months ended December 29, 2019 are primarily due to increased revenues in the current period and the impact of higher inventory reserves related to product originally manufactured for Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. and its affiliates (collectively, "Huawei") in the prior period that the Company was prevented from selling to Huawei, partially offset by unfavorable product mix shift.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 31.7% for the six months ended December 27, 2020 and 35.5% for the six months ended December 29, 2019.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating loss was $119.8 million for the six months ended December 27, 2020 compared to $105.6 million for the six months ended December 29, 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our total revenue increased by 3% during fiscal 2020 as compared to 2019, primarily due to increases in revenue of our Commercial and Industrial Solutions segment.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net cash provided by investing activities for the year ended January 3, 2021 was $129.2 million, which was the primarily result of: (i) $253.0 million proceeds from sale of equity investments; (ii) $15.4 million proceeds from business divestiture; (iii) $7.7 million proceeds from return of capital of equity investments with fair value option; and (iv) $6.6 million proceeds from maturities of marketable securities.
